small_strong.research_note: On past data this mix made about 20-25% a year with a worst fall of about 10-15% (Dec 2020 to Sep 2026). Past data, already seen; not a promise. The basket alone can fall much further.
small_strong.note: Paper book, no real orders. Reported before tax, like the other shadow books. No verdict before the first judging point (24 months, or 3 month-end gate-off spells, whichever is later).
small_strong.marking_note: The basket is priced at the 2:40 pm run only (Kite quotes). The 3:46 pm run re-marks Swing's positions but not the basket: that would need 25 more Kite calls (inbox 034). The 2:40 pm values are the book's daily marks.

swing_half.note: The paper mix holds Swing scaled to its half (fractional shares, as in the research engine). Stocks are at the 2:40 pm run's prices; the sleeve and cash are as that run leaves them, after its sleeve rebalance, so the rows can differ from the half's value by that rebalance's costs. Swing's results before 12 Nov are not part of this mix; it starts from Swing's value on 12 Nov.

morning.note: Marked at the morning price; no decision is made at this run.

signal_drift.note: Close list = the live VCP clause re-run at the next 10:40 update on the decide day's settled bars. Market cap and quarterly profit in the clause are read as of the re-run. Records only — the close list changes no decision.
